$comment: Machine-readable baseline for future comparison. Every value is either measured here or explicitly marked not_measured. No value is estimated unless the key says so.

audit.kind: audit-only; no code, configuration or data was changed

database.note: the repository .env points local development at the SHARED database; an embedded PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:54339 exists but is not configured for use

featureFlags.AUTH_DEV_MAGIC_LINKS: true but inert (disabled because DATABASE_URL is shared)

datasetSize.$comment: thin for operational tables; findings about row volume are structural, not observed

databaseRoundTrip.method: select 1 on a warm pooled connection, DATABASE_URL

emptyStaffTransaction.method: withContext equivalent: begin+set_config bundled, one select 1, commit (3 round trips)

querySweepInOneTransaction.method: n sequential select 1 inside one RLS transaction
querySweepInOneTransaction.shape: linear; nothing in the stack batches or pipelines queries

serverPaths.method: real service functions from @clinic-genie/db executed inside withContext against the real database, with the pg client's query method wrapped to count driver calls; 6 repetitions after one warm-up (4 for reports). Excludes React render and network transfer to the browser.

paths.name: layout: shell clients + active website ids

unauthenticatedHttpTtfb.method: curl time_starttransfer against the production build on port 3401, 8 samples per route
unauthenticatedHttpTtfb.conclusion: framework, routing and React server rendering cost single-digit milliseconds warm; authenticated route latency is database round trips plus external API calls

wixFormsApi.method: one token call, one submissions page, one form-schema call against one of eight configured bindings; not repeated, to respect rate limits

derived.$comment: arithmetic over the measured values above; not independently observed

notMeasured.reason: No authenticated session was obtainable. Development magic links are correctly disabled because DATABASE_URL points at a shared database (runtime-policy.ts localRehearsalDatabase); Google OAuth requires interactive consent; and creating a session row directly was refused by this environment's safety controls, correctly, since it would have written to the shared database. Separately, no monitoring of any kind is installed, so no field data exists.
notMeasured.unblockedBy: a seeded isolated staging database; the repository already contains the tooling (e2e-batch08/prepare.mts, server.mts, support.ts, playwright.batch08.config.ts)

findings.title: Live Wix Forms API calls block the dashboard and the enquiries page
Committed debug instrumentation transmits secret lengths before the authorisation check
findings.note: security defect, not a latency defect

findings.title: loadLiveBundle issues 15 sequential queries because publishedReport is two queries per report
/analytics/traffic and /analytics/behavior open two transactions where /analytics opens one
/seo runs 11 queries then opens a second transaction; over-fetches and filters in JavaScript; duplicates the client registry read
listEnquiryBoard runs six sequential queries, two byte-identical, and abandons pagination whenever Wix is configured
The client registry is loaded twice on most routes
Blog media is served with two transactions and an audit write per image, and is never cacheable
loadSiteView reads up to 20000 report snapshots on every analytics and report page
findings.evidence: code; costs nothing today because report_snapshots has 0 rows

findings.title: Server actions commonly use two or more serial transactions
No streaming, no loading states, no caching anywhere
The analytics worker is a single serial drain on a once-daily cron
findings.note: no interactive impact; becomes relevant if P0-1 is fixed by syncing

findings.title: Small inefficiencies: /analytics/behaviour redirect page, count-by-download from Wix, extra enquiryConnection probe, whole-file buffering, report-artifact directory walk

suspected.question: Real TTFB/LCP/INP/CLS on authenticated routes
suspected.settledBy: seeded staging database plus Playwright and Lighthouse

suspected.question: Vercel cold-start penalty on top of measured database time
suspected.settledBy: Vercel observability or a cold-instance probe

suspected.question: Which module staff actually perceive as slow
suspected.settledBy: RUM, or structured observation with staff

suspected.question: Whether ANALYTICS_LIVE_REPORTS affects perceived speed or only data availability
suspected.preliminaryAnswer: data availability; the UI distinguishes available/unavailable/not_connected explicitly. Do not flip for speed.

suspected.question: How many Wix submission pages a typical binding returns
suspected.note: the single sample returned 59 submissions with no next cursor (1 page); 3-5 pages would triple P0-1's cost

suspected.question: Whether pool max 8 saturates under concurrent staff use
suspected.note: derived threshold is ~9 concurrent heavy requests; most likely way measured times degrade in practice
suspected.settledBy: concurrency testing against a non-shared database

standardDatabaseQuery_p95_100ms.verdict: met per query but the wrong metric
standardDatabaseQuery_p95_100ms.note: warm round trip p95 is 11.2ms; the problem is 15-30 of them in series. Track round trips per route instead.

dashboardDataVisible_2s.status: at risk; 0.6-1.4s from Wix alone with no streaming

simpleFilterInteraction_300ms.status: at risk on /enquiries; not measured elsewhere

inp_200ms_p75.reason: no field data exists; small bundle is a favourable sign

cls_0.1_p75.reason: no field data exists; 4 blog img tags lack dimensions

specificationDiscrepancies.issue: committed debug code transmits secret-length metadata (P0-2)
no APM and no RUM installed; performance regressions are undetectable
Wix enquiry reads happen during page render rather than from a synchronised store; GA4, GSC, Wix Analytics and PageSpeed are correctly worker-synced
lib/storage.ts serves evidence and blog media from a local filesystem path; Vercel has no persistent filesystem
its row caps and pagination warning remain open; P2-1 and P1-4 are the same class of issue
its single-transaction analytics fix landed for /analytics only; /analytics/traffic and /analytics/behavior still use two

actionsExplicitlyNotTaken: no repeated third-party API calls beyond three single probes
no production configuration or environment variable change
no code fix applied, including the P0-2 security defect
